claims.summary: Exact instructor-only facts remain authoritative through local prompting and canonical compilation, including a facts-only retained state when unsafe teaching atoms are quarantined.
Early and canonical admission agree on ambiguous, equivalent, multi-supported, ordinal-leaking, and unsupported-scope choices.
Deterministic fallback assessment prompts use only the supplied fact list and explicitly separate source evidence from assumptions.
Exact-ledger builds avoid futile outer recovery and preserve compiler-owned facts after bounded local attempts.
The connected public Scion Agent uses compact dynamic workspace context and returns bounded plain Markdown without a tool-call envelope.
Seven fresh reversed-order pairs produce seven paid-reference wins and two score-qualified full lesson-kernel preference rows under the final current replay while local base admits zero.

The receipt binds campaign breadth, captures, current replays, paired judgments, admitted rows, implementation hashes, and unchanged frozen semantic replay results; the new V9 held-out ruler binds the changed transitive grader before any adapter run.
Gemma weights and adapter activation remain unchanged; shared semantic and compiler improvements apply to compatible paid routes while local runtime policy remains Scion-specific.
